title: Neutral Substrates: A Design Constraint for Shared Records Under Persistent Interpretive Disagreement
abstract: arXiv:2601.14271v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Shared accountability records must often remain useful to parties who disagree about causation, responsibility, and normative interpretation. Suppressing these claims would erase information needed for accountability; asserting one disputed interpretation as foundational would privilege it. A neutral substrate instead separates shared referential commitments from attributed interpretive assertions.   This paper formalizes that separation through admissible frameworks, referential commitments, permitted attributions, interpretive non-commitment, and extension stability. Under Referential Common Ground, restricting every substrate-layer commitment to a referential commitment or a permitted attribution proposition is sufficient for semantic neutrality relative to every admissible framework. It is not a design-time guarantee: such a guarantee requires a permitted basis establishing the neutrality result, rather than only its truth.   The

translated_title: 中立基底：持续性解释分歧下共享记录的一种设计约束
translated_abstract: 共享问责记录必须常常对那些在因果关系、责任和规范性解释上存在分歧的各方保持有用。压制这些分歧性主张会抹去问责所需的信息；而将某一有争议的解释断言为基础则会使其获得特权地位。中立基底转而将共享的指称承诺与归因性的解释断言分离开来。本文通过可采纳框架、指称承诺、允许归因、解释性不承诺以及扩展稳定性等形式化概念来刻画这种分离。在指称共同基础下，将每一个基底层的承诺限制为指称承诺或允许归因命题，即足以保证相对于所有可采纳框架的语义中立性。但这并非一种设计时保证：这样的保证需要一个能够确立该中立性结果的允许基础，而不仅仅是其真值为真。
tldr: 该论文提出“中立基底”这一设计约束，通过将共享的指称承诺与有争议的解释性归因断言相分离，使共享问责记录在各方存在持续性解释分歧时仍能保持语义中立性与有用性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "neutral substrates" as a design constraint that separates shared referential commitments from disputed interpretive attributions, enabling shared accountability records to remain semantically neutral and useful despite persistent interpretive disagreement among parties.
